title: Sign encoding preserves conjunction
statement: For Booleans $a$ and $b$, encode each as a sign in $\\{ -1,1 \\}$ using the given Boolean-to-sign equivalence. The encoding of $a \\land b$ is $-1$ exactly when both encoded signs are $-1$, and is $1$ otherwise.
